getfunction.desc: Returns {function_pointer} based on <function_path> and <function_name>. Does not trigger compilation or resolving of the script, therefore if the script isn't referenced by an include or far call by any other script at least once it will fail to find the function and return {undefined}.
getfunction.use_case: Useful in situations where you would like to reference a function that does not always exist in every context(map, gametype, game etc), without a unresolved external or compiler error occurring.
getfunction.fail_case: Fails when <function_path> and <function_name> cannot be resolved to a linked function.

returns.name: function_pointer
returns.desc: Returns undefined or a function pointer to <function_name>.

args.name: function_path
args.desc: Path to try to find function. Standard is to use forward slashes and not escaped backslashes. Script instance must match(gsc to gsc, or csc to csc). Is only the <function_path> component of a far call: <function_path>::<function_name>

args.name: function_name
args.desc: Function to retrive a pointer for. The <function_name> component of a far call: <function_path>::<function_name>

getfunctionname.desc: Returns {function_name} of the input <function_pointer> in "function_path::function_name" format.
getfunctionname.use_case: Useful for debugging when you would like to print the name of an arbitrary function pointer.

returns.name: function_name
returns.desc: Always returns a string upon correct usage.

args.name: function_pointer
args.desc: Script function to try to get the name of.

replacefunc.desc: Detours <from_function> to <to_function> causing subsequent calls to <from_function> to instead call <to_function>. Can detour any function including engine invoked script callbacks, except builtins. If [priority] is not specified defaults to 0 allowing for successive replacefunc calls with a higher [priority] value to detour already detoured functions.
replacefunc.use_case: Allows overriding existing vanilla behavior by overriding <from_function> to call your own <to_function>.
replacefunc.fail_case: Fails if the replacefunc call's priority is lower than an existing detour's priority
special_warnings: Attempting to override existing detour with lower priority.
Attempting to override existing detour with higher priority.

args.name: from_function
args.desc: Script function to replace calls to.

args.name: priority
args.desc: Priority value for successive replacefunc calls; the highest priority overall is what is called.

replacefunc.best_practices: Due to when the script VM may execute; if you want to guarantee your code overriding the original behavior you need to invoke replacefunc as early as possible. The best way to do that is in the main() of a custom script. Additionally, using replacefunc in tandem with getfunction can allow your script to be gametype/map/mode agnostic.
replacefunc.additional_notes: T6 ONLY: You can use the command "listscriptdetours" to list the currently applied detours from replacefunc calls.

getdetour.desc: Given a <function_pointer> return the the current {function_detour} for that function.
getdetour.use_case: For removedetour in order to remove the detour from <function_pointer>.

returns.name: function_detour
returns.desc: Return value {function_detour} is eligible for use as an argument for the removedetour builtin.
